facts.text: AWG33220A covers the Agilent 33220A and partially compatible generators such as the Agilent 33500 and the Rigol D1000
set_amplitude writes twice the requested value in Vpp and get_amplitude halves the Vpp reply
get_output and set_output use the boolean SCPI command :OUTPUT
The frequency is written and read in Hz with :FREQUENCY
get_phase selects degrees with :UNIT:ANGLE DEG before reading :PHASE?
The duty cycle is in percent and applies only to the square function
The function values are sine, square, ramp, pulse, noise, prbs, DC, user and arb
The burst mode is trig or gate
set_output(False) turns the generator output off
